lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I usually order a flat white, but yours tasted quite bitter yesterday.
lines.ipa: /aɪ jˈuːʒuːəli ˈɔːdəɹ ɐ flˈat wˈaɪt bˌʌt jˈɔːz tˈeɪstɪd kwˈaɪt bˈɪtə jˈɛstədˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We changed the beans this week. Would you prefer a lighter roast?
lines.ipa: /wiː tʃˈeɪndʒd ðə bˈiːnz ðɪs wˈiːk wʊd juː pɹɪfˈɜːɹ ɐ lˈaɪtə ɹˈəʊst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Maybe. I liked the old one because it was less sharp.
lines.ipa: /mˈeɪbiː aɪ lˈaɪkt ðɪ ˈəʊld wˈɒn bɪkˈɒz ɪt wɒz lˈɛs ʃˈɑːp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll make you a small sample before you choose.
lines.ipa: /aɪl mˌeɪk juː ɐ smˈɔːl sˈampəl bɪfˌɔː juː tʃˈuːz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm meeting someone who doesn't drink caffeine.
lines.ipa: /aɪm mˈiːtɪŋ sˈʌmwɒn hˌuː dˈʌzənt dɹˈɪŋk kˈafiːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Our fruit infusions are caffeine-free, although the green tea isn't.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə fɹˈuːt ɪnfjˈuːʒənz ɑː kˈafiːnfɹˈiː ɔːlðˈəʊ ðə ɡɹˈiːn tˈiː ˈɪzənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's useful. I nearly ordered green tea for both of us.
lines.ipa: /ðats jˈuːsfəl aɪ nˌiəli ˈɔːdəd ɡɹˈiːn tˈiː fɔː bˈəʊθ ɒv ˌʌs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll leave the boxes here so your friend can read the ingredients.
lines.ipa: /aɪl lˈiːv ðə bˈɒksɪz hˈiə sˌəʊ jɔː fɹˈɛnd kan ɹˈiːd ðɪ ɪŋɡɹˈiːdiənts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why is my coffee more expensive than hers? We ordered the same size.
lines.ipa: /wˌaɪ ɪz maɪ kˈɒfi mˈɔːɹ ɛkspˈɛnsɪv ðɐn hˈɜːz wiː ˈɔːdəd ðə sˈeɪm sˈaɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yours has almond milk. I should have mentioned the extra charge.
lines.ipa: /jˈɔːz hɐz ˈɒlmənd mˈɪlk aɪ ʃˌʊdəv mˈɛnʃənd ðɪ ˈɛkstɹə tʃˈɑːdʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't mind paying, but I couldn't find it on the board.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt mˈaɪnd pˈeɪɪŋ bˌʌt aɪ kˌʊdənt fˈaɪnd ɪt ɒnðə bˈɔːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're right. The price needs to be beside the milk choices.
lines.ipa: /jɔː ɹˈaɪt ðə pɹˈaɪs nˈiːdz təbi bɪsˌaɪd ðə mˈɪlk tʃˈɔɪsɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I brought a travel cup. Can you fill it to this line?
lines.ipa: /aɪ bɹˈɔːt ɐ tɹˈavəl kˈʌp kan juː fˈɪl ɪt tə ðɪs lˈaɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That leaves enough room for the lid, doesn't it?
lines.ipa: /ðat lˈiːvz ɪnˈʌf ɹˈuːm fəðə lˈɪd dˈʌzənt ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Last time the drink leaked into my bag.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli lˈast tˈaɪm ðə dɹˈɪŋk lˈiːkt ˌɪntʊ maɪ bˈaɡ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll wipe the outside as well before handing it back.
lines.ipa: /aɪl wˈaɪp ðɪ aʊtsˈaɪd az wˈɛl bɪfˌɔː hˈandɪŋ ɪt bˈak/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you cut that slice into two smaller pieces?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː kˈʌt ðat slˈaɪs ˌɪntʊ tˈuː smˈɔːlə pˈiːsɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course. Are they going on separate plates?
lines.ipa: /ɒv kˈɔːs ɑː ðeɪ ɡˌəʊɪŋ ˌɒn sˈɛpɹət plˈeɪts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. My son wants cake but never finishes a whole slice.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs maɪ sˈʌn wˈɒnts kˈeɪk bˌʌt nˈɛvə fˈɪnɪʃɪz ɐ hˈəʊl slˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I'll put the cream on the side so you can share it.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn aɪl pˌʊt ðə kɹˈiːm ɒnðə sˈaɪd sˌəʊ juː kan ʃˈeəɹ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This tastes of hazelnut, though I ordered vanilla.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs tˈeɪsts ɒv hˈeɪzəlnˌʌt ðˌəʊ aɪ ˈɔːdəd vɐnˈɪlə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Please don't drink any more while I check the order.
lines.ipa: /plˈiːz dˈəʊnt dɹˈɪŋk ˌɛni mˈɔː wˌaɪl aɪ tʃˈɛk ðɪ ˈɔːdə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't have an allergy; it's just not what I wanted.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt hav ɐn ˈalədʒi ɪts dʒˈʌst nˌɒt wɒt aɪ wˈɒntɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks for clarifying. I'll replace it rather than add more vanilla.
lines.ipa: /θˈaŋks fɔː klˈaɹɪfˌaɪɪŋ aɪl ɹɪplˈeɪs ɪt ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ˈad mˈɔː vɐnˈɪlə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Would you mind moving that bag from the empty chair?
lines.ipa: /wʊd juː mˈaɪnd mˈuːvɪŋ ðat bˈaɡ fɹʌmðɪ ˈɛmpti tʃˈeə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sorry, I was keeping the seat for my colleague.
lines.ipa: /sˈɒɹi aɪ wɒz kˈiːpɪŋ ðə sˈiːt fɔː maɪ kˈɒliːɡ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is she arriving soon? I'm only waiting for a takeaway.
lines.ipa: /ɪz ʃiː ɐɹˈaɪvɪŋ sˈuːn aɪm ˈəʊnli wˈeɪtɪŋ fəɹə tˈeɪkəwˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: She'll be another twenty minutes. You're welcome to sit there.
lines.ipa: /ʃiːl biː ɐnˈʌðə twˈɛnti mˈɪnɪts jɔː wˈɛlkʌm tə sˈɪt ðˈeə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think we've been charged for a sandwich we didn't receive.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɪŋk wiːv bˌiːn tʃˈɑːdʒd fəɹə sˈandwɪtʃ wiː dˈɪdnt ɹɪsˈiːv/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was it the toasted cheese one?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ɪt ðə tˈəʊstɪd tʃˈiːz wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. We cancelled it when you said the kitchen had closed.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs wiː kˈansəld ɪt wɛn juː sˈɛd ðə kˈɪtʃən had klˈəʊzd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can see the cancellation now. I'll take it off the bill.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan sˈiː ðə kˌansɪlˈeɪʃən nˈaʊ aɪl tˈeɪk ɪt ˈɒf ðə bˈɪl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We need somewhere for a book group on Thursday evenings.
lines.ipa: /wiː nˈiːd sˈʌmweə fəɹə bˈʊk ɡɹˈuːp ˌɒn θˈɜːzdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How many people usually come, and will you be ordering food?
lines.ipa: /hˌaʊ mˈɛni pˈiːpəl jˈuːʒuːəli kˈʌm and wɪl juː biː ˈɔːdəɹɪŋ fˈuːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Around eight, mostly drinks. We need to hear each other speak.
lines.ipa: /ɐɹˈaʊnd ˈeɪt mˈəʊstli dɹˈɪŋks wiː nˈiːd tə hˈiəɹ ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə spˈiːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The back room is quieter, but we'd need a regular booking.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈak ɹˈuːm ɪz kwˈaɪətə bˌʌt wiːd nˈiːd ɐ ɹˈɛɡjʊlə bˈʊkɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your staff were lovely, but our order disappeared twice.
lines.ipa: /jɔː stˈaf wɜː lˈʌvli bˌʌt ˌaʊəɹ ˈɔːdə dˌɪsɐpˈiəd twˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were both orders placed at the counter?
lines.ipa: /wɜː bˈəʊθ ˈɔːdəz plˈeɪst at ðə kˈaʊntə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One there and one through the table code.
lines.ipa: /wˈɒn ðeə and wˈɒn θɹuː ðə tˈeɪbəl kˈəʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That may explain the confusion. I'll check how those two systems connect.
lines.ipa: /ðat mˈeɪ ɛksplˈeɪn ðə kənfjˈuːʒən aɪl tʃˈɛk hˌaʊ ðəʊz tˈuː sˈɪstəmz kənˈɛkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The cheaper ticket says I must travel after nine thirty.
lines.ipa: /ðə tʃˈiːpə tˈɪkɪt sˈɛz aɪ mˈʌst tɹˈavəl ˈaftə nˈaɪn θˈɜːti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: My train leaves at nine twenty-eight. Does that really make a difference?
lines.ipa: /maɪ tɹˈeɪn lˈiːvz at nˈaɪn twˈɛntiˈeɪt dˈʌz ðat ɹˈiəlɪ mˌeɪk ɐ dˈɪfɹəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Unfortunately it does. The restriction is based on departure time.
lines.ipa: /ʌnfˈɔːtʃənətli ɪt dˈʌz ðə ɹɪstɹˈɪkʃən ɪz bˈeɪst ˌɒn dɪpˈɑːtʃə tˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I'll take the next one rather than risk paying again.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn aɪl tˈeɪk ðə nˈɛkst wˈɒn ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɹˈɪsk pˈeɪɪŋ ɐɡˈɛn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've followed the signs, but they keep sending me round the same block.
lines.ipa: /aɪv fˈɒləʊd ðə sˈaɪnz bˌʌt ðeɪ kˈiːp sˈɛndɪŋ mˌiː ɹˈaʊnd ðə sˈeɪm blˈɒk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The old bus stop signs haven't all been removed.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈəʊld bˈʌs stˈɒp sˈaɪnz hˈavənt ˈɔːl bˌiːn ɹɪmˈuːvd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the temporary stop isn't outside the station?
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə tˈɛmpɹəɹi stˈɒp ˌɪzənt aʊtsˈaɪd ðə stˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, it's beside the cinema. I'll point it out from here.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ ɪts bɪsˌaɪd ðə sˈɪnəmə aɪl pˈɔɪnt ɪt ˈaʊt fɹɒm hˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My first train was cancelled, and the app wants me to buy a new ticket.
lines.ipa: /maɪ fˈɜːst tɹˈeɪn wɒz kˈansəld and ðɪ ˈap wˈɒnts mˌiː tə bˈaɪ ɐ njˈuː tˈɪkɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't buy it yet. Your existing ticket may cover the alternative route.
lines.ipa: /dˈəʊnt bˈaɪ ɪt jˈɛt jɔːɹ ɛɡzˈɪstɪŋ tˈɪkɪt mˈeɪ kˈʌvə ðɪ ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪv ɹˈuːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Even though that train belongs to a different company?
lines.ipa: /ˈiːvən ðˌəʊ ðat tɹˈeɪn bɪlˈɒŋz tʊ ɐ dˈɪfɹənt kˈʌmpəni/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Check the disruption notice. It lists which services are accepting tickets.
lines.ipa: /tʃˈɛk ðə dɪsɹˈʌpʃən nˈəʊtɪs ɪt lˈɪsts wˌɪtʃ sˈɜːvɪsɪz ɑːɹ ɐksˈɛptɪŋ tˈɪkɪts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Someone has taken a suitcase that looks exactly like mine.
lines.ipa: /sˈʌmwɒn hɐz tˈeɪkən ɐ sˈuːtkeɪs ðat lˈʊks ɛɡzˈaktli lˈaɪk mˈaɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is the one left on the belt the same model?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðə wˈɒn lˈɛft ɒnðə bˈɛlt ðə sˈeɪm mˈɒdəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, but the label has a different name.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs bˌʌt ðə lˈeɪbəl hɐz ɐ dˈɪfɹənt nˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Give the desk that name. They can contact the other passenger privately.
lines.ipa: /ɡˈɪv ðə dˈɛsk ðat nˈeɪm ðeɪ kan kˈɒntakt ðɪ ˈʌðə pˈasɪndʒə pɹˈaɪvətli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We have forty minutes between flights, and we're still on the ground.
lines.ipa: /wiː hav fˈɔːti mˈɪnɪts bɪtwˌiːn flˈaɪts and wiə stˈɪl ɒnðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you booked both flights on the same reservation?
lines.ipa: /hav juː bˈʊkt bˈəʊθ flˈaɪts ɒnðə sˈeɪm ɹˌɛzəvˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, so I expected the connection to be possible.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs sˌəʊ aɪ ɛkspˈɛktɪd ðə kənˈɛkʃən təbi pˈɒsɪbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tell the airline staff now. They can check what happens if we miss it.
lines.ipa: /tˈɛl ðɪ ˈeəlaɪn stˈaf nˈaʊ ðeɪ kan tʃˈɛk wɒt hˈapənz ɪf wiː mˈɪs ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The bike's front light works, but the rear one doesn't.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈaɪkz fɹˈʌnt lˈaɪt wˈɜːks bˌʌt ðə ɹˈiə wˈɒn dˈʌzənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you notice before leaving the hire station?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː nˈəʊtɪs bɪfˌɔː lˈiːvɪŋ ðə hˈaɪə stˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: About two streets away. I've brought it straight back.
lines.ipa: /ɐbˌaʊt tˈuː stɹˈiːts ɐwˈeɪ aɪv bɹˈɔːt ɪt stɹˈeɪt bˈak/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks. We'll swap the bike and record the fault.
lines.ipa: /θˈaŋks wiːl swˈɒp ðə bˈaɪk and ɹˈɛkɔːd ðə fˈɒlt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The app calls this route accessible, but it includes a long staircase.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈap kˈɔːlz ðɪs ɹˈuːt aksˈɛsəbəl bˌʌt ɪt ɪŋklˈuːdz ɐ lˈɒŋ stˈeəkeɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could it be referring only to the station entrance?
lines.ipa: /kʊd ɪt biː ɹɪfˈɜːɹɪŋ ˈəʊnli tə ðə stˈeɪʃən ˈɛntɹəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Maybe, but that isn't clear when you plan the whole journey.
lines.ipa: /mˈeɪbiː bˌʌt ðat ˌɪzənt klˈiə wɛn juː plˈan ðə hˈəʊl dʒˈɜːni/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll report the route itself, not just the broken lift.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ɹɪpˈɔːt ðə ɹˈuːt ɪtsˈɛlf nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ðə bɹˈəʊkən lˈɪft/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The driver wants a separate payment for each of us.
lines.ipa: /ðə dɹˈaɪvə wˈɒnts ɐ sˈɛpɹət pˈeɪmənt fɔː ˈiːtʃ əv ˌʌs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did we agree on two fares or one shared journey?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd wiː ɐɡɹˈiː ˌɒn tˈuː fˈeəz ɔː wˈɒn ʃˈeəd dʒˈɜːni/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One journey. We gave both addresses before getting in.
lines.ipa: /wˈɒn dʒˈɜːni wiː ɡˈeɪv bˈəʊθ ɐdɹˈɛsɪz bɪfˌɔː ɡˌɛtɪŋ ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's check the booking message before either of us pays.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛts tʃˈɛk ðə bˈʊkɪŋ mˈɛsɪdʒ bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈaɪðəɹ ɒv ˌʌs pˈeɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The refund form asks for a ticket number I can't find.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈiːfʌnd fˈɔːm ˈasks fəɹə tˈɪkɪt nˈʌmbəɹ aɪ kˈɑːnt fˈaɪnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It may be on the original confirmation rather than the payment receipt.
lines.ipa: /ɪt mˈeɪ biː ɒnðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ðə pˈeɪmənt ɹɪsˈiːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I only saved a screenshot of the code.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈəʊnli sˈeɪvd ɐ skɹˈiːnʃɒt ɒvðə kˈəʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep that screenshot. Customer support should tell you which number they need.
lines.ipa: /kˈiːp ðat skɹˈiːnʃɒt kˈʌstəmə səpˈɔːt ʃˌʊd tˈɛl juː wˌɪtʃ nˈʌmbə ðeɪ nˈiːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Flying saves two hours, but getting to the airport adds nearly as much.
lines.ipa: /flˈaɪɪŋ sˈeɪvz tˈuː ˈaʊəz bˌʌt ɡˌɛtɪŋ tə ðɪ ˈeəpɔːt ˈadz nˌiəli az mˈʌtʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The train arrives right in the city centre too.
lines.ipa: /ðə tɹˈeɪn ɐɹˈaɪvz ɹˈaɪt ɪnðə sˈɪti sˈɛntə tˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And we'd avoid paying for a taxi at the other end.
lines.ipa: /and wiːd ɐvˈɔɪd pˈeɪɪŋ fəɹə tˈaksi at ðɪ ˈʌðəɹ ˈɛnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Once we include those costs, the train seems the better option.
lines.ipa: /wˈʌns wiː ɪŋklˈuːd ðəʊz kˈɒsts ðə tɹˈeɪn sˈiːmz ðə bˈɛtəɹ ˈɒpʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our booking is confirmed, but you say there are no rooms.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə bˈʊkɪŋ ɪz kənfˈɜːmd bˌʌt juː sˈeɪ ðeəɹˌɑː nˈəʊ ɹˈuːmz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The system has your arrival down as yesterday.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɪstəm hɐz jɔːɹ ɐɹˈaɪvəl dˌaʊn az jˈɛstədˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The confirmation on my phone clearly shows today's date.
lines.ipa: /ðə kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən ˌɒn maɪ fˈəʊn klˈiəli ʃˈəʊz tədˈeɪz dˈeɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're correct. Let me call the duty manager before we discuss alternatives.
lines.ipa: /jɔː kəɹˈɛkt lˈɛt mˌiː kˈɔːl ðə djˈuːti mˈanɪdʒə bɪfˌɔː wiː dɪskˈʌs ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪvz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The breakfast charge appeared even though we booked room only.
lines.ipa: /ðə bɹˈɛkfəst tʃˈɑːdʒ ɐpˈiəd ˈiːvən ðˌəʊ wiː bˈʊkt ɹˈuːm ˈəʊnli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you visit the restaurant this morning?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː vˈɪzɪt ðə ɹˈɛstɹɒnt ðɪs mˈɔːnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only to meet our friends. We didn't order anything.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli tə mˈiːt ˌaʊə fɹˈɛndz wiː dˈɪdnt ˈɔːdəɹ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll check with the restaurant and remove any charge made in error.
lines.ipa: /aɪl tʃˈɛk wɪððə ɹˈɛstɹɒnt and ɹɪmˈuːv ˌɛni tʃˈɑːdʒ mˌeɪd ɪn ˈɛɹə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We asked for a quiet room because my partner works nights.
lines.ipa: /wiː ˈaskt fəɹə kwˈaɪət ɹˈuːm bɪkˈɒz maɪ pˈɑːtnə wˈɜːks nˈaɪts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The room you've been given is quiet after the restaurant closes.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈuːm juːv bˌiːn ɡˈɪvən ɪz kwˈaɪət ˈaftə ðə ɹˈɛstɹɒnt klˈəʊzɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: She needs to sleep during the day, though.
lines.ipa: /ʃiː nˈiːdz tə slˈiːp djˈʊəɹɪŋ ðə dˈeɪ ðˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I see. A room above the garden would suit you better.
lines.ipa: /aɪ sˈiː ɐ ɹˈuːm əbˌʌv ðə ɡˈɑːdən wʊd sˈuːt juː bˈɛtə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd like late checkout, but I don't need the room cleaned.
lines.ipa: /aɪd lˈaɪk lˈeɪt tʃˈɛkaʊt bˌʌt aɪ dˈəʊnt nˈiːd ðə ɹˈuːm klˈiːnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The main issue is preparing it for the next guest.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈeɪn ˈɪʃuː ɪz pɹɪpˈeəɹɪŋ ɪt fəðə nˈɛkst ɡˈɛst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could we leave our bags somewhere and just use the lounge?
lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː lˈiːv ˌaʊə bˈaɡz sˈʌmweə and dʒˈʌst jˈuːz ðə lˈaʊndʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Absolutely. That option won't require extending your room booking.
lines.ipa: /ˌabsəlˈuːtli ðat ˈɒpʃən wəʊnt ɹɪkwˈaɪəɹ ɛkstˈɛndɪŋ jɔː ɹˈuːm bˈʊkɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I returned the borrowed charger, but the deposit hasn't appeared.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɹɪtˈɜːnd ðə bˈɒɹəʊd tʃˈɑːdʒə bˌʌt ðə dɪpˈɒzɪt hˈazənt ɐpˈiəd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the deposit taken in cash or held on your card?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə dɪpˈɒzɪt tˈeɪkən ɪn kˈaʃ ɔː hˈɛld ˌɒn jɔː kˈɑːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was a card hold when we checked in.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wʌzɐ kˈɑːd hˈəʊld wɛn wiː tʃˈɛkt ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll give you written confirmation that we've released it.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ɡˈɪv juː ɹˈɪtən kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən ðat wiːv ɹɪlˈiːst ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One of my shirts came back from the laundry with a mark.
lines.ipa: /wˈɒn ɒv maɪ ʃˈɜːts kˈeɪm bˈak fɹʌmðə lˈɔːndɹi wɪð ɐ mˈɑːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you still have the laundry receipt?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː juː stˈɪl hav ðə lˈɔːndɹi ɹɪsˈiːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, and I took a photo before sending it down.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs and aɪ tˈʊk ɐ fˈəʊtəʊ bɪfˌɔː sˈɛndɪŋ ɪt dˈaʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Please leave the shirt with reception so the laundry team can investigate.
lines.ipa: /plˈiːz lˈiːv ðə ʃˈɜːt wɪð ɹɪsˈɛpʃən sˌəʊ ðə lˈɔːndɹi tˈiːm kan ɪnvˈɛstɪɡˌeɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We booked a family room, and one person can no longer come.
lines.ipa: /wiː bˈʊkt ɐ fˈamɪli ɹˈuːm and wˈɒn pˈɜːsən kan nˌəʊ lˈɒŋɡə kˈʌm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Would you like to change rooms or keep the space?
lines.ipa: /wʊd juː lˈaɪk tə tʃˈeɪndʒ ɹˈuːmz ɔː kˈiːp ðə spˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Keep the room, but can the extra breakfast be removed?
lines.ipa: /kˈiːp ðə ɹˈuːm bˌʌt kan ðɪ ˈɛkstɹə bɹˈɛkfəst biː ɹɪmˈuːvd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The room rate stays the same, but breakfast is charged separately.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðə ɹˈuːm ɹˈeɪt stˈeɪz ðə sˈeɪm bˌʌt bɹˈɛkfəst ɪz tʃˈɑːdʒd sˈɛpɹətli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My key stopped working after I kept it beside my phone.
lines.ipa: /maɪ kˈiː stˈɒpt wˈɜːkɪŋ ˈaftəɹ aɪ kˈɛpt ɪt bɪsˌaɪd maɪ fˈəʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sometimes the card needs to be reset.
lines.ipa: /sˈʌmtaɪmz ðə kˈɑːd nˈiːdz təbi ɹɪsˈɛt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you check it before issuing another one?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː tʃˈɛk ɪt bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈɪʃuːɪŋ ɐnˈʌðə wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course. I'll also confirm that the checkout date is correct.
lines.ipa: /ɒv kˈɔːs aɪl ˈɔːlsəʊ kənfˈɜːm ðatðə tʃˈɛkaʊt dˈeɪt ɪz kəɹˈɛkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The bill includes a minibar item we didn't use.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈɪl ɪŋklˈuːdz ɐ mˈɪnɪbˌɑːɹ ˈaɪtəm wiː dˈɪdnt jˈuːz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which item is listed?
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ ˈaɪtəm ɪz lˈɪstɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A bottle of juice. We only drank the tap water.
lines.ipa: /ɐ bˈɒtəl ɒv dʒˈuːs wiː ˈəʊnli dɹˈaŋk ðə tˈap wˈɔːtə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll ask housekeeping to check the stock record.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ˈask hˈaʊskiːpɪŋ tə tʃˈɛk ðə stˈɒk ɹˈɛkɔːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I almost gave the hotel a poor review because of the building work.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈɔːlməʊst ɡˈeɪv ðə həʊtˈɛl ɐ pˈʊə ɹɪvjˈuː bɪkˈɒz ɒvðə bˈɪldɪŋ wˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the noise a problem throughout your stay?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə nˈɔɪz ɐ pɹˈɒbləm θɹuːˈaʊt jɔː stˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only on the first day, and the staff moved us promptly.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɒnðə fˈɜːst dˈeɪ and ðə stˈaf mˈuːvd ˌʌs pɹˈɒmptli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then mentioning both the problem and the response would give a fairer picture.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn mˈɛnʃənɪŋ bˈəʊθ ðə pɹˈɒbləm and ðə ɹɪspˈɒns wʊd ɡˈɪv ɐ fˈeəɹə pˈɪktʃə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm looking for a shirt I can wear to work without ironing it every morning.
lines.ipa: /aɪm lˈʊkɪŋ fəɹə ʃˈɜːt aɪ kan wˈeə tə wˈɜːk wɪðˌaʊt ˈaɪənɪŋ ɪt ˈɛvɹɪ mˈɔːnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: This fabric creases less, but it feels slightly warmer.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs fˈabɹɪk kɹˈiːsɪz lˈɛs bˌʌt ɪt fˈiːlz slˈaɪtli wˈɔːmə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I try it under the jacket I usually wear?
lines.ipa: /kan aɪ tɹˈaɪ ɪt ˌʌndə ðə dʒˈakɪt aɪ jˈuːʒuːəli wˈeə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Certainly. Comfort matters more than how it looks on the hanger.
lines.ipa: /sˈɜːtənli kˈʌmfət mˈatəz mˈɔː ðɐn hˌaʊ ɪt lˈʊks ɒnðə hˈaŋə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd like to exchange these shoes, although I've worn them indoors.
lines.ipa: /aɪd lˈaɪk tʊ ɛkstʃˈeɪndʒ ðiːz ʃˈuːz ɔːlðˈəʊ aɪv wˈɔːn ðˌɛm ɪndˈɔːz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was that just to check the fit?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ðat dʒˈʌst tə tʃˈɛk ðə fˈɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. After ten minutes I realised they pressed against my heel.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ˈaftə tˈɛn mˈɪnɪts aɪ ɹˈiəlaɪzd ðeɪ pɹˈɛst ɐɡˈɛnst maɪ hˈiːl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us inspect the soles and discuss a size that might work better.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ˌʌs ɪnspˈɛkt ðə sˈəʊlz and dɪskˈʌs ɐ sˈaɪz ðat mˌaɪt wˈɜːk bˈɛtə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The advertised discount makes this seem cheaper than the smaller pack.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈadvətˌaɪzd dˈɪskaʊnt mˌeɪks ðɪs sˈiːm tʃˈiːpə ðɐn ðə smˈɔːlə pˈak/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you compared the price per item?
lines.ipa: /hav juː kəmpˈeəd ðə pɹˈaɪs pɜːɹ ˈaɪtəm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not yet. The large label distracted me.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt jˈɛt ðə lˈɑːdʒ lˈeɪbəl dɪstɹˈaktɪd mˌiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The shelf has both figures. The smaller pack is actually better value today.
lines.ipa: /ðə ʃˈɛlf hɐz bˈəʊθ fˈɪɡəz ðə smˈɔːlə pˈak ɪz ˈaktʃuːəli bˈɛtə vˈaljuː tədˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The replacement headphones have developed the same fault as the first pair.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt hˈɛdfəʊnz hav dɪvˈɛləpt ðə sˈeɪm fˈɒlt az ðə fˈɜːst pˈeə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you have the record of the earlier exchange?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː juː hav ðə ɹˈɛkɔːd ɒvðɪ ˈɜːlɪəɹ ɛkstʃˈeɪndʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. I don't want to keep replacing the same model.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt tə kˈiːp ɹɪplˈeɪsɪŋ ðə sˈeɪm mˈɒdəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We'll look at the full history before offering the next step.
lines.ipa: /wiːl lˈʊk at ðə fˈʊl hˈɪstəɹi bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈɒfəɹɪŋ ðə nˈɛkst stˈɛp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I received a collection message, but the shop says the parcel hasn't arrived.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɹɪsˈiːvd ɐ kəlˈɛkʃən mˈɛsɪdʒ bˌʌt ðə ʃˈɒp sˈɛz ðə pˈɑːsəl hˈazənt ɐɹˈaɪvd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The message might have been sent when it reached the local depot.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ mˌaɪthɐv bˌiːn sˈɛnt wɛn ɪt ɹˈiːtʃt ðə lˈəʊkəl dˈɛpəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It specifically says ready to collect, though.
lines.ipa: /ɪt spəsˈɪfɪkli sˈɛz ɹˈɛdi tə kəlˈɛkt ðˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then you shouldn't have made the journey. I'll check where the scan happened.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn juː ʃˌʊdənthəv mˌeɪd ðə dʒˈɜːni aɪl tʃˈɛk wˌeə ðə skˈan hˈapənd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I sent a gift directly to my friend, and she received the price invoice.
lines.ipa: /aɪ sˈɛnt ɐ ɡˈɪft daɪɹˈɛktli tə maɪ fɹˈɛnd and ʃiː ɹɪsˈiːvd ðə pɹˈaɪs ˈɪnvɔɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you select the gift option at checkout?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː sɪlˈɛkt ðə ɡˈɪft ˈɒpʃən at tʃˈɛkaʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I did. I kept a screenshot because it was her birthday.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈɪd aɪ kˈɛpt ɐ skɹˈiːnʃɒt bɪkˈɒz ɪt wɒz hɜː bˈɜːθdeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Please send that to us so we can find out what went wrong.
lines.ipa: /plˈiːz sˈɛnd ðat tʊ ˌʌs sˌəʊ wiː kan fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt wɒt wɛnt ɹˈɒŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your voucher says ten pounds off, but I only saved three.
lines.ipa: /jɔː vˈaʊtʃə sˈɛz tˈɛn pˈaʊndz ˈɒf bˌʌt aɪ ˈəʊnli sˈeɪvd θɹˈiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The discount stops when the order reaches the minimum spend.
lines.ipa: /ðə dˈɪskaʊnt stˈɒps wɛn ðɪ ˈɔːdə ɹˈiːtʃɪz ðə mˈɪnɪməm spˈɛnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That condition wasn't visible on the offer page.
lines.ipa: /ðat kəndˈɪʃən wˌɒzn̩t vˈɪzɪbəl ɒnðɪ ˈɒfə pˈeɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll compare the page with the full terms before answering you.
lines.ipa: /aɪl kəmpˈeə ðə pˈeɪdʒ wɪððə fˈʊl tˈɜːmz bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈansəɹɪŋ juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The used bicycle is cheaper, but it needs a new chain soon.
lines.ipa: /ðə jˈuːzd bˈaɪsɪkəl ɪz tʃˈiːpə bˌʌt ɪt nˈiːdz ɐ njˈuː tʃˈeɪn sˈuːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has the shop included that in the asking price?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ðə ʃˈɒp ɪŋklˈuːdɪd ðat ɪnðɪ ˈaskɪŋ pɹˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They reduced it a little after showing me the inspection sheet.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ɹɪdjˈuːst ɪt ɐ lˈɪtəl ˈaftə ʃˈəʊɪŋ mˌiː ðɪ ɪnspˈɛkʃən ʃˈiːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then compare the total repair cost with a bike that's ready to ride.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn kəmpˈeə ðə tˈəʊtəl ɹɪpˈeə kˈɒst wɪð ɐ bˈaɪk ðats ɹˈɛdi tə ɹˈaɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why are you putting the item in another box? It already has one.
lines.ipa: /wˌaɪ ɑː juː pˈʊtɪŋ ðɪ ˈaɪtəm ɪn ɐnˈʌðə bˈɒks ɪt ɔːlɹˈɛdi hɐz wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The outer box protects it during delivery.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈaʊtə bˈɒks pɹətˈɛkts ɪt djˈʊəɹɪŋ dɪlˈɪvəɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm collecting it on foot, so I won't need that.
lines.ipa: /aɪm kəlˈɛktɪŋ ɪt ˌɒn fˈʊt sˌəʊ aɪ wəʊnt nˈiːd ðˈat/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In that case, we can leave the extra packaging here.
lines.ipa: /ɪn ðat kˈeɪs wiː kan lˈiːv ðɪ ˈɛkstɹə pˈakɪdʒɪŋ hˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've pre-ordered the book twice because the first payment looked unsuccessful.
lines.ipa: /aɪv pɹˈiːˈɔːdəd ðə bˈʊk twˈaɪs bɪkˈɒz ðə fˈɜːst pˈeɪmənt lˈʊkt ʌnsəksˈɛsfəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you have two confirmation numbers?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː juː hav tˈuː kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən nˈʌmbəz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, and both payments now appear on my statement.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs and bˈəʊθ pˈeɪmənts nˈaʊ ɐpˈiəɹ ˌɒn maɪ stˈeɪtmənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't place another order. We'll identify and cancel the duplicate.
lines.ipa: /dˈəʊnt plˈeɪs ɐnˈʌðəɹ ˈɔːdə wiːl aɪdˈɛntɪfˌaɪ and kˈansəl ðə djˈuːplɪkˌeɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The cleaning rota looks equal, but the bathroom takes much longer than the hall.
lines.ipa: /ðə klˈiːnɪŋ ɹˈəʊtə lˈʊks ˈiːkwəl bˌʌt ðə bˈaθɹuːm tˈeɪks mˈʌtʃ lˈɒŋɡə ðɐn ðə hˈɔːl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I hadn't thought about the time involved.
lines.ipa: /aɪ hˈadənt θˈɔːt ɐbˌaʊt ðə tˈaɪm ɪnvˈɒlvd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could we swap jobs each week instead of keeping the same ones?
lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː swˈɒp dʒˈɒbz ˈiːtʃ wˈiːk ɪnstˈɛd ɒv kˈiːpɪŋ ðə sˈeɪm wˌɒnz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That would let everyone see how much work each job needs.
lines.ipa: /ðat wʊd lˈɛt ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn sˈiː hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ wˈɜːk ˈiːtʃ dʒˈɒb nˈiːdz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The plumber repaired the tap, but the cupboard underneath is still damp.
lines.ipa: /ðə plˈʌmə ɹɪpˈeəd ðə tˈap bˌʌt ðə kˈʌbəd ˌʌndənˈiːθ ɪz stˈɪl dˈamp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did anyone check the pipe behind the washing machine?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ˈɛnɪwˌɒn tʃˈɛk ðə pˈaɪp bɪhˌaɪnd ðə wˈɒʃɪŋ məʃˈiːn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. We assumed the tap was the only source.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ wiː ɐsjˈuːmd ðə tˈap wʌzðɪ ˈəʊnli sˈɔːs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's record where the water appears before arranging another visit.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛts ɹˈɛkɔːd wˌeə ðə wˈɔːtəɹ ɐpˈiəz bɪfˌɔːɹ ɐɹˈeɪndʒɪŋ ɐnˈʌðə vˈɪzɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I lent my ladder to someone and now a step is bent.
lines.ipa: /aɪ lˈɛnt maɪ lˈadə tə sˈʌmwɒn and nˈaʊ ɐ stˈɛp ɪz bˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have they told you what happened?
lines.ipa: /hav ðeɪ tˈəʊld juː wɒt hˈapənd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They said it was already like that, but I used it yesterday.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ sˈɛd ɪt wɒz ɔːlɹˌɛdi lˈaɪk ðˈat bˌʌt aɪ jˈuːzd ɪt jˈɛstədˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'd stop using it and speak to them before lending anything else.
lines.ipa: /aɪd stˈɒp jˈuːzɪŋ ɪt and spˈiːk tə ðˌɛm bɪfˌɔː lˈɛndɪŋ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ˈɛls/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The delivery driver left my parcel with a neighbour who is away.
lines.ipa: /ðə dɪlˈɪvəɹi dɹˈaɪvə lˈɛft maɪ pˈɑːsəl wɪð ɐ nˈeɪbə hˌuː ɪz ɐwˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you know when they're coming back?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː juː nˈəʊ wɛn ðeɪə kˈʌmɪŋ bˈak/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not for another week, and I need the contents for work.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt fɔːɹ ɐnˈʌðə wˈiːk and aɪ nˈiːd ðə kˈɒntɛnts fɔː wˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Contact the delivery company with the photo rather than trying to enter the property.
lines.ipa: /kˈɒntakt ðə dɪlˈɪvəɹi kˈʌmpəni wɪððə fˈəʊtəʊ ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn tɹˈaɪɪŋ tʊ ˈɛntə ðə pɹˈɒpəti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My neighbour's washing machine runs against our bedroom wall every night.
lines.ipa: /maɪ nˈeɪbəz wˈɒʃɪŋ məʃˈiːn ɹˈʌnz ɐɡˈɛnst ˌaʊə bˈɛdɹuːm wˈɔːl ˈɛvɹɪ nˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you told them when you hear it?
lines.ipa: /hav juː tˈəʊld ðˌɛm wɛn juː hˈiəɹ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I mentioned the noise, but not the time.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mˈɛnʃənd ðə nˈɔɪz bˌʌt nˌɒt ðə tˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A specific example may help them understand what needs to change.
lines.ipa: /ɐ spəsˈɪfɪk ɛɡzˈampəl mˈeɪ hˈɛlp ðˌɛm ˌʌndəstˈand wɒt nˈiːdz tə tʃˈeɪndʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The person applying for our spare room works from home all week.
lines.ipa: /ðə pˈɜːsən ɐplˈaɪɪŋ fɔːɹ ˌaʊə spˈeə ɹˈuːm wˈɜːks fɹɒm hˈəʊm ˈɔːl wˈiːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Would that be a problem for the shared space?
lines.ipa: /wʊd ðat biː ɐ pɹˈɒbləm fəðə ʃˈeəd spˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only if they expect the kitchen table to be their desk.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɪf ðeɪ ɛkspˈɛkt ðə kˈɪtʃən tˈeɪbəl təbi ðeə dˈɛsk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then discuss working arrangements before agreeing to the tenancy.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn dɪskˈʌs wˈɜːkɪŋ ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənts bɪfˌɔːɹ ɐɡɹˈiːɪŋ tə ðə tˈɛnənsi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We packed the things we'll need first at the bottom of the van.
lines.ipa: /wiː pˈakt ðə θˈɪŋz wiːl nˈiːd fˈɜːst at ðə bˈɒtəm ɒvðə vˈan/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is there a way to unload them separately?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðeəɹ ɐ wˈeɪ tʊ ʌnlˈəʊd ðˌɛm sˈɛpɹətli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not easily. The bedding is behind every piece of furniture.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt ˈiːzili ðə bˈɛdɪŋ ɪz bɪhˌaɪnd ˈɛvɹɪ pˈiːs ɒv fˈɜːnɪtʃə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Next time we'll label an essentials box and keep it with us.
lines.ipa: /nˈɛkst tˈaɪm wiːl lˈeɪbəl ɐn ɪsˈɛnʃəlz bˈɒks and kˈiːp ɪt wɪð ˌʌs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new washing machine uses less energy, yet our bills haven't fallen.
lines.ipa: /ðə njˈuː wˈɒʃɪŋ məʃˈiːn jˈuːsɪz lˈɛs ˈɛnədʒi jˈɛt ˌaʊə bˈɪlz hˈavənt fˈɔːlən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are we doing the same number of washes?
lines.ipa: /ɑː wiː dˌuːɪŋ ðə sˈeɪm nˈʌmbəɹ ɒv wˈɒʃɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Probably more, because the new one is so convenient.
lines.ipa: /pɹˈɒbəbli mˈɔː bɪkˈɒz ðə njˈuː wˈɒn ɪz sˌəʊ kənvˈiːnɪənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The lower cost per wash doesn't mean the total use has dropped.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈəʊə kˈɒst pɜː wˈɒʃ dˈʌzənt mˈiːn ðə tˈəʊtəl jˈuːs hɐz dɹˈɒpt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The rent increase is small, but the new agreement removes our parking space.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈɛnt ˈɪŋkɹiːs ɪz smˈɔːl bˌʌt ðə njˈuː ɐɡɹˈiːmənt ɹɪmˈuːvz ˌaʊə pˈɑːkɪŋ spˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the parking included in the original contract?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə pˈɑːkɪŋ ɪŋklˈuːdɪd ɪnðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl kˈɒntɹakt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. I nearly signed because I only checked the monthly amount.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs aɪ nˌiəli sˈaɪnd bɪkˈɒz aɪ ˈəʊnli tʃˈɛkt ðə mˈʌnθli ɐmˈaʊnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's worth comparing the whole agreement, not just the price.
lines.ipa: /ɪts wˈɜːθ kəmpˈeəɹɪŋ ðə hˈəʊl ɐɡɹˈiːmənt nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ðə pɹˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our cat hid from the neighbour and missed two meals while we were away.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə kˈat hˈɪd fɹʌmðə nˈeɪbə and mˈɪst tˈuː mˈiːlz wˌaɪl wiː wɜːɹ ɐwˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the neighbour stay long enough for her to come out?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðə nˈeɪbə stˈeɪ lˈɒŋ ɪnˈʌf fɔː hɜː tə kˈʌm ˈaʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: She visited at the agreed times, but left quickly.
lines.ipa: /ʃiː vˈɪzɪtɪd at ðɪ ɐɡɹˈiːd tˈaɪmz bˌʌt lˈɛft kwˈɪkli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We need a plan that suits the animal, not just a list of feeding times.
lines.ipa: /wiː nˈiːd ɐ plˈan ðat sˈuːts ðɪ ˈanɪməl nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ɐ lˈɪst ɒv fˈiːdɪŋ tˈaɪmz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I booked the first available appointment, then realised I couldn't get there by bus.
lines.ipa: /aɪ bˈʊkt ðə fˈɜːst ɐvˈeɪləbəl ɐpˈɔɪntmənt ðˈɛn ɹˈiəlaɪzd aɪ kˌʊdənt ɡɛt ðeə baɪ bˈʌs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the system show the location before you confirmed?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðə sˈɪstəm ʃˈəʊ ðə ləʊkˈeɪʃən bɪfˌɔː juː kənfˈɜːmd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, but I didn't know it was the branch outside town.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs bˌʌt aɪ dˈɪdnt nˈəʊ ɪt wʌzðə bɹˈantʃ aʊtsˈaɪd tˈaʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask about the nearer branch instead of simply missing the appointment.
lines.ipa: /ˈask ɐbˌaʊt ðə nˈiəɹə bɹˈantʃ ɪnstˈɛd ɒv sˈɪmpli mˈɪsɪŋ ðɪ ɐpˈɔɪntmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The exercise class is described as suitable for everyone.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɛksəsˌaɪz klˈas ɪz dɪskɹˈaɪbd az sˈuːtəbəl fɔːɹ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you find that accurate?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː fˈaɪnd ðat ˈakjʊɹət/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Most exercises were done on the floor, which didn't work for me.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊst ˈɛksəsˌaɪzɪz wɜː dˈʌn ɒnðə flˈɔː wˌɪtʃ dˈɪdnt wˈɜːk fɔː mˌiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tell the organiser which part was difficult so they can explain the available options.
lines.ipa: /tˈɛl ðɪ ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzə wˌɪtʃ pˈɑːt wɒz dˈɪfɪkəlt sˌəʊ ðeɪ kan ɛksplˈeɪn ðɪ ɐvˈeɪləbəl ˈɒpʃənz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I keep saying yes to evening commitments because I don't want to disappoint people.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kˈiːp sˈeɪɪŋ jˈɛs tʊ ˈiːvnɪŋ kəmˈɪtmənts bɪkˈɒz aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt tə dˌɪsɐpˈɔɪnt pˈiːpəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then you end up cancelling when you're exhausted?
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn juː ˈɛnd ˌʌp kˈansəlɪŋ wɛn jɔːɹ ɛɡzˈɔːstɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. It makes me feel less reliable, not more.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ɪt mˌeɪks mˌiː fˈiːl lˈɛs ɹɪlˈaɪəbəl nˌɒt mˈɔː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps deciding earlier would be kinder to everyone involved.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps dɪsˈaɪdɪŋ ˈɜːlɪə wʊd biː kˈaɪndə tʊ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ɪnvˈɒlvd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The restaurant gave us an allergy menu from last season.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈɛstɹɒnt ɡˈeɪv ˌʌs ɐn ˈalədʒi mˈɛnjuː fɹɒm lˈast sˈiːzən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did they confirm whether the dishes have changed?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðeɪ kənfˈɜːm wˈɛðə ðə dˈɪʃɪz hav tʃˈeɪndʒd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They said probably not, which wasn't reassuring.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ sˈɛd pɹˈɒbəbli nˈɒt wˌɪtʃ wˌɒzn̩t ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask them to check the current information rather than rely on the old sheet.
lines.ipa: /ˈask ðˌɛm tə tʃˈɛk ðə kˈʌɹənt ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɹɪlˈaɪ ɒnðɪ ˈəʊld ʃˈiːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our walking group wants to move faster, but two members would be left behind.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə wˈɔːkɪŋ ɡɹˈuːp wˈɒnts tə mˈuːv fˈastə bˌʌt tˈuː mˈɛmbəz wʊd biː lˈɛft bɪhˈaɪnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could you have two groups following different routes?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː hav tˈuː ɡɹˈuːps fˈɒləʊɪŋ dˈɪfɹənt ɹˈuːts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We'd need another leader, but both routes could end together.
lines.ipa: /wiːd nˈiːd ɐnˈʌðə lˈiːdə bˌʌt bˈəʊθ ɹˈuːts kʊd ˈɛnd təɡˈɛðə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds more welcoming than asking people to keep up at any cost.
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈaʊndz mˈɔː wˈɛlkʌmɪŋ ðɐn ˈaskɪŋ pˈiːpəl tə kˈiːp ˌʌp at ˌɛni kˈɒst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The refill point is free, yet almost nobody uses it.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪfˈɪl pˈɔɪnt ɪz fɹˈiː jˈɛt ˈɔːlməʊst nˈəʊbɒdi jˈuːsɪz ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is it easy to find from the main entrance?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ɪt ˈiːzi tə fˈaɪnd fɹʌmðə mˈeɪn ˈɛntɹəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not really. The sign is behind a tall display.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt ɹˈiəlɪ ðə sˈaɪn ɪz bɪhˌaɪnd ɐ tˈɔːl dɪsplˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Move the sign before assuming people prefer bottled water.
lines.ipa: /mˈuːv ðə sˈaɪn bɪfˌɔːɹ ɐsjˈuːmɪŋ pˈiːpəl pɹɪfˈɜː bˈɒtəld wˈɔːtə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My calendar has a break at lunchtime, but colleagues keep booking over it.
lines.ipa: /maɪ kˈaləndə hɐz ɐ bɹˈeɪk at lˈʌntʃtaɪm bˌʌt kˈɒliːɡz kˈiːp bˈʊkɪŋ ˈəʊvəɹ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do they see that time as available?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː ðeɪ sˈiː ðat tˈaɪm az ɐvˈeɪləbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The calendar says tentative, so perhaps they do.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˈaləndə sˈɛz tˈɛntətˌɪv sˌəʊ pəhˈaps ðeɪ dˈuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Make the status clear and explain when you can take their calls.
lines.ipa: /mˌeɪk ðə stˈeɪtəs klˈiə and ɛksplˈeɪn wɛn juː kan tˈeɪk ðeə kˈɔːlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The replacement class costs more because it's run by a different instructor.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt klˈas kˈɒsts mˈɔː bɪkˈɒz ɪts ɹˈʌn baɪ ɐ dˈɪfɹənt ɪnstɹˈʌktə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was an extra charge mentioned when the first class was cancelled?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ɐn ˈɛkstɹə tʃˈɑːdʒ mˈɛnʃənd wɛn ðə fˈɜːst klˈas wɒz kˈansəld/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. We were told our bookings would transfer.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ wiː wɜː tˈəʊld ˌaʊə bˈʊkɪŋz wʊd tɹansfˈɜː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the organiser needs to explain the change before taking any payment.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðɪ ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzə nˈiːdz tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn ðə tʃˈeɪndʒ bɪfˌɔː tˈeɪkɪŋ ˌɛni pˈeɪmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've stopped recording my progress because I keep missing the target.
lines.ipa: /aɪv stˈɒpt ɹɪkˈɔːdɪŋ maɪ pɹˈəʊɡɹɛs bɪkˈɒz aɪ kˈiːp mˈɪsɪŋ ðə tˈɑːɡɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does the target still reflect the time you actually have?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ðə tˈɑːɡɪt stˈɪl ɹɪflˈɛkt ðə tˈaɪm juː ˈaktʃuːəli hˈav/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, it was based on a quiet week last month.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ ɪt wɒz bˈeɪst ˌɒn ɐ kwˈaɪət wˈiːk lˈast mˈʌnθ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You could review the target without treating that as a failure.
lines.ipa: /juː kʊd ɹɪvjˈuː ðə tˈɑːɡɪt wɪðˌaʊt tɹˈiːtɪŋ ðat az ɐ fˈeɪliə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The sports centre improved the main entrance but left the changing area unchanged.
lines.ipa: /ðə spˈɔːts sˈɛntəɹ ɪmpɹˈuːvd ðə mˈeɪn ˈɛntɹəns bˌʌt lˈɛft ðə tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ ˈeəɹiəɹ ʌntʃˈeɪndʒd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did they ask users to test the whole route?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðeɪ ˈask jˈuːzəz tə tˈɛst ðə hˈəʊl ɹˈuːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They only checked whether people could enter the building.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ˈəʊnli tʃˈɛkt wˈɛðə pˈiːpəl kʊd ˈɛntə ðə bˈɪldɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Access needs to work for the visit, not just the front door.
lines.ipa: /ˈaksɛs nˈiːdz tə wˈɜːk fəðə vˈɪzɪt nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ðə fɹˈʌnt dˈɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The library has the book, but only as a reference copy.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈaɪbɹəɹi hɐz ðə bˈʊk bˌʌt ˈəʊnli az ɐ ɹˈɛfɹəns kˈɒpɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Can you use it in the reading room?
lines.ipa: /kan juː jˈuːz ɪt ɪnðə ɹˈiːdɪŋ ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, though I can't stay during the library's usual hours.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðˌəʊ aɪ kˈɑːnt stˈeɪ djˈʊəɹɪŋ ðə lˈaɪbɹəɹiz jˈuːʒuːəl ˈaʊəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask whether another edition is available to borrow before buying one.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wˈɛðəɹ ɐnˈʌðəɹ ɪdˈɪʃən ɪz ɐvˈeɪləbəl tə bˈɒɹəʊ bɪfˌɔː bˈaɪɪŋ wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I answered the homework question, but I lost marks for the method.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈansəd ðə hˈəʊmwɜːk kwˈɛstʃən bˌʌt aɪ lˈɒst mˈɑːks fəðə mˈɛθəd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were you asked to show each stage?
lines.ipa: /wɜː juː ˈaskt tə ʃˈəʊ ˈiːtʃ stˈeɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Apparently, but I only wrote the final answer.
lines.ipa: /ɐpˈaɹəntli bˌʌt aɪ ˈəʊnli ɹˈəʊt ðə fˈaɪnəl ˈansə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask which steps demonstrate understanding rather than just adding more writing.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wˌɪtʃ stˈɛps dˈɛmənstɹˌeɪt ˌʌndəstˈandɪŋ ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn dʒˈʌst ˈadɪŋ mˈɔː ɹˈaɪtɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We spend so much time organising our study group that we rarely study.
lines.ipa: /wiː spˈɛnd sˈəʊ mˌʌtʃ tˈaɪm ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzɪŋ ˌaʊə stˈʌdi ɡɹˈuːp ðat wiː ɹˈeəli stˈʌdi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How many people have to agree on each session?
lines.ipa: /hˌaʊ mˈɛni pˈiːpəl hav tʊ ɐɡɹˈiː ˌɒn ˈiːtʃ sˈɛʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: All twelve. Even choosing a chapter becomes a discussion.
lines.ipa: /ˈɔːl twˈɛlv ˈiːvən tʃˈuːzɪŋ ɐ tʃˈaptə bɪkˌʌmz ɐ dɪskˈʌʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try setting a regular time and letting people join when they can.
lines.ipa: /tɹˈaɪ sˈɛtɪŋ ɐ ɹˈɛɡjʊlə tˈaɪm and lˈɛtɪŋ pˈiːpəl dʒˈɔɪn wɛn ðeɪ kˈan/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My extension was approved, but the submission system still shows the old deadline.
lines.ipa: /maɪ ɛkstˈɛnʃən wɒz ɐpɹˈuːvd bˌʌt ðə səbmˈɪʃən sˈɪstəm stˈɪl ʃˈəʊz ðɪ ˈəʊld dˈɛdlaɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you saved the approval message?
lines.ipa: /hav juː sˈeɪvd ðɪ ɐpɹˈuːvəl mˈɛsɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. I'm worried an automatic late penalty will appear.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs aɪm wˈʌɹid ɐn ˌɔːtəmˈatɪk lˈeɪt pˈɛnəlti wɪl ɐpˈiə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Send the message to the course office while there's still time to correct it.
lines.ipa: /sˈɛnd ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ tə ðə kˈɔːs ˈɒfɪs wˌaɪl ðeəz stˈɪl tˈaɪm tə kəɹˈɛkt ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The teacher's feedback says my argument is clear but not supported.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈiːtʃəz fˈiːdbak sˈɛz maɪ ˈɑːɡjuːmənt ɪz klˈiə bˌʌt nˌɒt səpˈɔːtɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does each paragraph include evidence?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ˈiːtʃ pˈaɹəɡɹˌaf ɪŋklˈuːd ˈɛvɪdəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I mostly explain what I think, then repeat it in the conclusion.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mˈəʊstli ɛksplˈeɪn wɒt aɪ θˈɪŋk ðˈɛn ɹɪpˈiːt ɪt ɪnðə kəŋklˈuːʒən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Choose one claim and show how a source or example supports it.
lines.ipa: /tʃˈuːz wˈɒn klˈeɪm and ʃˈəʊ hˌaʊ ɐ sˈɔːs ɔːɹ ɛɡzˈampəl səpˈɔːts ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This course promises advanced conversation, but the sample lesson looks quite basic.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs kˈɔːs pɹˈɒmɪsɪz ɐdvˈanst kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən bˌʌt ðə sˈampəl lˈɛsən lˈʊks kwˈaɪt bˈeɪsɪk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you asked who the course is intended for?
lines.ipa: /hav juː ˈaskt hˌuː ðə kˈɔːs ɪz ɪntˈɛndɪd fɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They said anyone who wants to improve.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ sˈɛd ˈɛnɪwˌɒn hˌuː wˈɒnts tʊ ɪmpɹˈuːv/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Request the actual level requirements before paying for a place.
lines.ipa: /ɹɪkwˈɛst ðɪ ˈaktʃuːəl lˈɛvəl ɹɪkwˈaɪəmənts bɪfˌɔː pˈeɪɪŋ fəɹə plˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can give my presentation from memory until someone interrupts.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan ɡˈɪv maɪ pɹˌɛzəntˈeɪʃən fɹɒm mˈɛməɹi ʌntˈɪl sˈʌmwɒn ˈɪntəɹˌʌpts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you practised answering questions during it?
lines.ipa: /hav juː pɹˈaktɪst ˈansəɹɪŋ kwˈɛstʃənz djˈʊəɹɪŋ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. I always rehearse from the first sentence to the last.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ɹɪhˈɜːs fɹʌmðə fˈɜːst sˈɛntəns tə ðə lˈast/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try starting from different points so one interruption doesn't break the whole sequence.
lines.ipa: /tɹˈaɪ stˈɑːtɪŋ fɹɒm dˈɪfɹənt pˈɔɪnts sˌəʊ wˈɒn ˌɪntəɹˈʌpʃən dˈʌzənt bɹˈeɪk ðə hˈəʊl sˈiːkwəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The recording of our online lesson has no captions.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪkˈɔːdɪŋ ɒv ˌaʊəɹ ˈɒnlaɪn lˈɛsən hɐz nˈəʊ kˈapʃənz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did anyone request them before the course began?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ˈɛnɪwˌɒn ɹɪkwˈɛst ðˌɛm bɪfˌɔː ðə kˈɔːs bɪɡˈan/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, and the course page said recordings would be accessible.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs and ðə kˈɔːs pˈeɪdʒ sˈɛd ɹɪkˈɔːdɪŋz wʊd biː aksˈɛsəbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep that information when you ask the provider to resolve it.
lines.ipa: /kˈiːp ðat ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən wɛn juː ˈask ðə pɹəvˈaɪdə tə ɹɪzˈɒlv ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two websites quote the same statistic, but neither links to the research.
lines.ipa: /tˈuː wˈɛbsaɪts kwˈəʊt ðə sˈeɪm stɐtˈɪstɪk bˌʌt nˈaɪðə lˈɪŋks tə ðə ɹɪsˈɜːtʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Maybe they copied it from each other.
lines.ipa: /mˈeɪbiː ðeɪ kˈɒpɪd ɪt fɹɒm ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's what I suspect. The number looks unusually exact.
lines.ipa: /ðats wɒt aɪ səspˈɛkt ðə nˈʌmbə lˈʊks ʌnjˈuːʒuːəli ɛɡzˈakt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Trace the earliest source rather than treating repeated claims as separate evidence.
lines.ipa: /tɹˈeɪs ðɪ ˈɜːlɪɪst sˈɔːs ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn tɹˈiːtɪŋ ɹɪpˈiːtɪd klˈeɪmz az sˈɛpɹət ˈɛvɪdəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can recognise every term in my notes, but I struggle to explain them.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪz ˈɛvɹɪ tˈɜːm ɪn maɪ nˈəʊts bˌʌt aɪ stɹˈʌɡəl tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you tried closing the notes and teaching one idea to someone?
lines.ipa: /hav juː tɹˈaɪd klˈəʊzɪŋ ðə nˈəʊts and tˈiːtʃɪŋ wˈɒn aɪdˈiə tə sˈʌmwɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not yet. Reading everything again feels safer.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt jˈɛt ɹˈiːdɪŋ ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ɐɡˈɛn fˈiːlz sˈeɪfə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That might show you which parts you understand and which only look familiar.
lines.ipa: /ðat mˌaɪt ʃˈəʊ juː wˌɪtʃ pˈɑːts juː ˌʌndəstˈand and wˌɪtʃ ˈəʊnli lˈʊk fəmˈɪliə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our meeting has sixteen people, although only three need to make the decision.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə mˈiːtɪŋ hɐz sˈɪkstiːn pˈiːpəl ɔːlðˈəʊ ˈəʊnli θɹˈiː nˈiːd tə mˌeɪk ðə dɪsˈɪʒən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could the others send updates beforehand?
lines.ipa: /kʊd ðɪ ˈʌðəz sˈɛnd ˈʌpdeɪts bɪfˈɔːhand/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Probably. Most just read out information from the shared document.
lines.ipa: /pɹˈɒbəbli mˈəʊst dʒˈʌst ɹˈiːd ˈaʊt ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən fɹʌmðə ʃˈeəd dˈɒkjuːmənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then separate the updates from the discussion that actually needs everyone.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn sˈɛpəɹˌeɪt ðɪ ˈʌpdeɪts fɹʌmðə dɪskˈʌʃən ðat ˈaktʃuːəli nˈiːdz ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I keep receiving new tasks because I finish the earlier ones quickly.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kˈiːp ɹɪsˈiːvɪŋ njˈuː tˈasks bɪkˈɒz aɪ fˈɪnɪʃ ðɪ ˈɜːlɪə wˈɒnz kwˈɪkli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you explained what you're already responsible for?
lines.ipa: /hav juː ɛksplˈeɪnd wɒt jɔːɹ ɔːlɹˌɛdi ɹɪspˈɒnsɪbəl fɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I usually say yes and catch up after hours.
lines.ipa: /aɪ jˈuːʒuːəli sˈeɪ jˈɛs and kˈatʃ ˌʌp ˈaftəɹ ˈaʊəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Make the workload visible before people assume you have spare capacity.
lines.ipa: /mˌeɪk ðə wˈɜːkləʊd vˈɪzɪbəl bɪfˌɔː pˈiːpəl ɐsjˈuːm juː hav spˈeə kəpˈasɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The remote-working trial went well, but management wants everyone back full-time.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪmˈəʊtwˈɜːkɪŋ tɹˈaɪəl wɛnt wˈɛl bˌʌt mˈanɪdʒmənt wˈɒnts ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn bˈak fˈʊltˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have they explained which problems returning would solve?
lines.ipa: /hav ðeɪ ɛksplˈeɪnd wˌɪtʃ pɹˈɒbləmz ɹɪtˈɜːnɪŋ wʊd sˈɒlv/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They mainly say that collaboration happens naturally in person.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ mˈeɪnli sˈeɪ ðat kəlˌabəɹˈeɪʃən hˈapənz nˈatʃəɹəli ɪn pˈɜːsən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It may help to compare specific examples from the trial rather than argue in general terms.
lines.ipa: /ɪt mˈeɪ hˈɛlp tə kəmpˈeə spəsˈɪfɪk ɛɡzˈampəlz fɹʌmðə tɹˈaɪəl ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ˈɑːɡjuː ɪn dʒˈɛnəɹəl tˈɜːmz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The guide tells new staff to ask a colleague whenever they're unsure.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɡˈaɪd tˈɛlz njˈuː stˈaf tʊ ˈask ɐ kˈɒliːɡ wɛnˌɛvə ðeɪəɹ ʌnʃˈʊə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds reasonable, but what happens when the colleague is wrong?
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈaʊndz ɹˈiːzənəbəl bˌʌt wɒt hˈapənz wɛn ðə kˈɒliːɡ ɪz ɹˈɒŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Different people teach the same task in different ways.
lines.ipa: /dˈɪfɹənt pˈiːpəl tˈiːtʃ ðə sˈeɪm tˈask ɪn dˈɪfɹənt wˈeɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We need one agreed process that people can check, not just informal advice.
lines.ipa: /wiː nˈiːd wˈɒn ɐɡɹˈiːd pɹˈəʊsɛs ðat pˈiːpəl kan tʃˈɛk nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ɪnfˈɔːməl ɐdvˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We can meet the deadline if we leave out the testing.
lines.ipa: /wiː kan mˈiːt ðə dˈɛdlaɪn ɪf wiː lˈiːv ˈaʊt ðə tˈɛstɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Would the customer know the difference before using it?
lines.ipa: /wʊd ðə kˈʌstəmə nˈəʊ ðə dˈɪfɹəns bɪfˌɔː jˈuːzɪŋ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Probably not, which makes the shortcut tempting.
lines.ipa: /pɹˈɒbəbli nˈɒt wˌɪtʃ mˌeɪks ðə ʃˈɔːtkʌt tˈɛmptɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then we need to explain the risk instead of calling an untested delivery finished.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn wiː nˈiːd tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn ðə ɹˈɪsk ɪnstˈɛd ɒv kˈɔːlɪŋ ɐn ʌntˈɛstɪd dɪlˈɪvəɹi fˈɪnɪʃt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new starter is friendly, but nobody has explained who decides what.
lines.ipa: /ðə njˈuː stˈɑːtəɹ ɪz fɹˈɛndli bˌʌt nˈəʊbɒdi hɐz ɛksplˈeɪnd hˌuː dɪsˈaɪdz wˈɒt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has the induction covered roles as well as systems?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ðɪ ɪndˈʌkʃən kˈʌvəd ɹˈəʊlz az wˈɛl az sˈɪstəmz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mostly passwords, forms and where to find the printer.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊstli pˈaswɜːdz fˈɔːmz and wˌeə tə fˈaɪnd ðə pɹˈɪntə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Arrange a few short introductions around the work they'll actually be doing.
lines.ipa: /ɐɹˈeɪndʒ ɐ fjˈuː ʃˈɔːt ˌɪntɹədˈʌkʃənz ɐɹˈaʊnd ðə wˈɜːk ðeɪl ˈaktʃuːəli biː dˈuːɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I thought my colleague rejected my idea, but she was questioning the budget.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɔːt maɪ kˈɒliːɡ ɹɪdʒˈɛktɪd maɪ aɪdˈiə bˌʌt ʃiː wɒz kwˈɛstʃənɪŋ ðə bˈʌdʒɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you ask which part she disagreed with?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː ˈask wˌɪtʃ pˈɑːt ʃiː dˌɪsɐɡɹˈiːd wɪð/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. I started defending the whole proposal.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ aɪ stˈɑːtɪd dɪfˈɛndɪŋ ðə hˈəʊl pɹəpˈəʊzəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Clarifying the objection first could save both of you a difficult conversation.
lines.ipa: /klˈaɹɪfˌaɪɪŋ ðɪ ɒbdʒˈɛkʃən fˈɜːst kʊd sˈeɪv bˈəʊθ ɒv juː ɐ dˈɪfɪkəlt kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The report is accurate, but readers can't tell which figures have changed.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪpˈɔːt ɪz ˈakjʊɹət bˌʌt ɹˈiːdəz kˈɑːnt tˈɛl wˌɪtʃ fˈɪɡəz hav tʃˈeɪndʒd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could we highlight the changes instead of making them compare two long files?
lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː hˈaɪlaɪt ðə tʃˈeɪndʒɪz ɪnstˈɛd ɒv mˌeɪkɪŋ ðˌɛm kəmpˈeə tˈuː lˈɒŋ fˈaɪlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. We already have the earlier version.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs wiː ɔːlɹˌɛdi hav ðɪ ˈɜːlɪə vˈɜːʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a short explanation as well, so the reason for each change is clear.
lines.ipa: /ˈad ɐ ʃˈɔːt ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən az wˈɛl sˌəʊ ðə ɹˈiːzən fɔːɹ ˈiːtʃ tʃˈeɪndʒ ɪz klˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our suggestion scheme gets plenty of ideas, but nobody hears what happens next.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə sədʒˈɛstʃən skˈiːm ɡˈɛts plˈɛnti ɒv aɪdˈiəz bˌʌt nˈəʊbɒdi hˈiəz wɒt hˈapənz nˈɛkst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do the people submitting them get a reply?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː ðə pˈiːpəl səbmˈɪtɪŋ ðˌɛm ɡɛt ɐ ɹɪplˈaɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only an automatic thank-you message.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɐn ˌɔːtəmˈatɪk θˈaŋkjuː mˈɛsɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Even a reason for not proceeding would show that someone has considered the proposal.
lines.ipa: /ˈiːvən ɐ ɹˈiːzən fɔː nˌɒt pɹəsˈiːdɪŋ wʊd ʃˈəʊ ðat sˈʌmwɒn hɐz kənsˈɪdəd ðə pɹəpˈəʊzəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm taking over a project with dozens of messages but no decision record.
lines.ipa: /aɪm tˈeɪkɪŋ ˌəʊvəɹ ɐ pɹˈɒdʒɛkt wɪð dˈʌzənz ɒv mˈɛsɪdʒɪz bˌʌt nˈəʊ dɪsˈɪʒən ɹˈɛkɔːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Can the previous lead give you a short handover call?
lines.ipa: /kan ðə pɹˈiːviəs lˈiːd ɡˈɪv juː ɐ ʃˈɔːt hˈandəʊvə kˈɔːl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: She's available tomorrow, though only for half an hour.
lines.ipa: /ʃiːz ɐvˈeɪləbəl təmˈɒɹəʊ ðˌəʊ ˈəʊnli fɔː hˈɑːf ɐn ˈaʊə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use that time to identify the decisions and open questions rather than read every message.
lines.ipa: /jˈuːs ðat tˈaɪm tʊ aɪdˈɛntɪfˌaɪ ðə dɪsˈɪʒənz and ˈəʊpən kwˈɛstʃənz ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɹˈiːd ˈɛvɹɪ mˈɛsɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our team shares one login because it's easier than creating separate accounts.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə tˈiːm ʃˈeəz wˈɒn lˈɒɡɪn bɪkˈɒz ɪts ˈiːziə ðɐn kɹiːˈeɪtɪŋ sˈɛpɹət ɐkˈaʊnts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does that make it difficult to see who changed a document?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ðat mˌeɪk ɪt dˈɪfɪkəlt tə sˈiː hˌuː tʃˈeɪndʒd ɐ dˈɒkjuːmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Last week we couldn't trace an accidental deletion.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs lˈast wˈiːk wiː kˌʊdənt tɹˈeɪs ɐn ˌaksɪdˈɛntəl dɪlˈiːʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Convenience is costing us accountability. Let's ask about individual access.
lines.ipa: /kənvˈiːnɪəns ɪz kˈɒstɪŋ ˌʌs ɐkˌaʊntəbˈɪlɪti lˈɛts ˈask ɐbˌaʊt ˌɪndɪvˈɪdʒuːəl ˈaksɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The client could view the draft yesterday, but today the link is blocked.
lines.ipa: /ðə klˈaɪənt kʊd vjˈuː ðə dɹˈaft jˈɛstədˌeɪ bˌʌt tədˈeɪ ðə lˈɪŋk ɪz blˈɒkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the file moved into a different folder?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə fˈaɪl mˈuːvd ˌɪntʊ ɐ dˈɪfɹənt fˈəʊldə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. I didn't realise that would affect the permissions.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs aɪ dˈɪdnt ɹˈiəlaɪz ðat wʊd ɐfˈɛkt ðə pəmˈɪʃənz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Check the new folder's rules before sending another link.
lines.ipa: /tʃˈɛk ðə njˈuː fˈəʊldəz ɹˈuːlz bɪfˌɔː sˈɛndɪŋ ɐnˈʌðə lˈɪŋk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We have a backup drive, but nobody has tried restoring a file from it.
lines.ipa: /wiː hav ɐ bˈakʌp dɹˈaɪv bˌʌt nˈəʊbɒdi hɐz tɹˈaɪd ɹɪstˈɔːɹɪŋ ɐ fˈaɪl fɹɒm ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is it even clear which folders are included?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ɪt ˈiːvən klˈiə wˌɪtʃ fˈəʊldəz ɑːɹ ɪŋklˈuːdɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not since we reorganised the shared space.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt sˈɪns wiː ɹɪˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzd ðə ʃˈeəd spˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A successful backup message isn't enough. We should test a small restore.
lines.ipa: /ɐ səksˈɛsfəl bˈakʌp mˈɛsɪdʒ ˌɪzənt ɪnˈʌf wiː ʃˌʊd tˈɛst ɐ smˈɔːl ɹɪstˈɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I muted the work chat, then missed a genuinely urgent message.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mjˈuːtɪd ðə wˈɜːk tʃˈat ðˈɛn mˈɪst ɐ dʒˈɛnjuːɪnli ˈɜːdʒənt mˈɛsɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could urgent issues use a different channel?
lines.ipa: /kʊd ˈɜːdʒənt ˈɪʃuːz jˈuːs ɐ dˈɪfɹənt tʃˈanəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We never agreed what counts as urgent.
lines.ipa: /wiː nˈɛvəɹ ɐɡɹˈiːd wɒt kˈaʊnts az ˈɜːdʒənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's the conversation to have before turning every notification back on.
lines.ipa: /ðats ðə kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən tə hav bɪfˌɔː tˈɜːnɪŋ ˈɛvɹɪ nˌəʊtɪfɪkˈeɪʃən bˈak ˈɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The update solved a bug, but removed a feature our team relied on.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈʌpdeɪt sˈɒlvd ɐ bˈʌɡ bˌʌt ɹɪmˈuːvd ɐ fˈiːtʃəɹ ˌaʊə tˈiːm ɹɪlˈaɪd ˈɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the removal mentioned in the release notes?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə ɹɪmˈuːvəl mˈɛnʃənd ɪnðə ɹɪlˈiːs nˈəʊts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was, buried near the bottom.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wˈɒz bˈɛɹid nˌiə ðə bˈɒtəm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We should check important changes before rolling future updates out to everyone.
lines.ipa: /wiː ʃˌʊd tʃˈɛk ɪmpˈɔːtənt tʃˈeɪndʒɪz bɪfˌɔː ɹˈəʊlɪŋ fjˈuːtʃəɹ ˈʌpdeɪts ˈaʊt tʊ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Support asked me to restart the router for the third time.
lines.ipa: /səpˈɔːt ˈaskt mˌiː tə ɹɪstˈɑːt ðə ɹˈuːtə fəðə θˈɜːd tˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you given them a record of when the connection drops?
lines.ipa: /hav juː ɡˈɪvən ðˌɛm ɐ ɹˈɛkɔːd ɒv wɛn ðə kənˈɛkʃən dɹˈɒps/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've described it, but I haven't kept times.
lines.ipa: /aɪv dɪskɹˈaɪbd ɪt bˌʌt aɪ hˈavənt kˈɛpt tˈaɪmz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A short log might help move the investigation beyond the standard checklist.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ʃˈɔːt lˈɒɡ mˌaɪt hˈɛlp mˈuːv ðɪ ɪnvˌɛstɪɡˈeɪʃən bɪjˌɒnd ðə stˈandəd tʃˈɛklɪst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The app says my data is anonymous, yet it still asks for my exact location.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈap sˈɛz maɪ dˈeɪtəɹ ɪz ɐnˈɒnəməs jˈɛt ɪt stˈɪl ˈasks fɔː maɪ ɛɡzˈakt ləʊkˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does it explain why that level of detail is needed?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ɪt ɛksplˈeɪn wˌaɪ ðat lˈɛvəl ɒv dˈiːteɪl ɪz nˈiːdɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only that it improves the service.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ðˌatɪt ɪmpɹˈuːvz ðə sˈɜːvɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's too general. I'd look for a clearer explanation before enabling it.
lines.ipa: /ðats tˈuː dʒˈɛnəɹəl aɪd lˈʊk fəɹə klˈiəɹəɹ ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən bɪfˌɔːɹ ɛnˈeɪblɪŋ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new website works with bigger text until the payment screen.
lines.ipa: /ðə njˈuː wˈɛbsaɪt wˈɜːks wɪð bˈɪɡə tˈɛkst ʌntˈɪl ðə pˈeɪmənt skɹˈiːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What happens there?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt hˈapənz ðˈeə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two buttons overlap, and I can't tell which one is selected.
lines.ipa: /tˈuː bˈʌtənz ˌəʊvəlˈap and aɪ kˈɑːnt tˈɛl wˌɪtʃ wˈɒn ɪz sɪlˈɛktɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Include that step in the report. The earlier pages alone don't show the problem.
lines.ipa: /ɪŋklˈuːd ðat stˈɛp ɪnðə ɹɪpˈɔːt ðɪ ˈɜːlɪə pˈeɪdʒɪz ɐlˈəʊn dˈəʊnt ʃˈəʊ ðə pɹˈɒbləm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The assistant produced a convincing answer with a reference that doesn't exist.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɐsˈɪstənt pɹədjˈuːst ɐ kənvˈɪnsɪŋ ˈansə wɪð ɐ ɹˈɛfɹəns ðat dˈʌzənt ɛɡzˈɪst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did anyone check it before putting it in the report?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ˈɛnɪwˌɒn tʃˈɛk ɪt bɪfˌɔː pˈʊtɪŋ ɪt ɪnðə ɹɪpˈɔːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Luckily, one person searched for the source.
lines.ipa: /lˈʌkili wˈɒn pˈɜːsən sˈɜːtʃt fəðə sˈɔːs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We need that check built into the process, not left to whoever happens to notice.
lines.ipa: /wiː nˈiːd ðat tʃˈɛk bˈɪlt ˌɪntʊ ðə pɹˈəʊsɛs nˌɒt lˈɛft tə huːˈɛvə hˈapənz tə nˈəʊtɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I thought I'd cancelled, but I had only turned off the reminder emails.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɔːt aɪd kˈansəld bˌʌt aɪ had ˈəʊnli tˈɜːnd ˈɒf ðə ɹɪmˈaɪndəɹ ˈiːmeɪlz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the cancellation option labelled clearly?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə kˌansɪlˈeɪʃən ˈɒpʃən lˈeɪbəld klˈiəli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not at all. It was several screens away.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt at ˈɔːl ɪt wɒz sˈɛvɹəl skɹˈiːnz ɐwˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Save the confirmation once you finish, so there's no doubt about what changed.
lines.ipa: /sˈeɪv ðə kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən wˈʌns juː fˈɪnɪʃ sˌəʊ ðeəz nˈəʊ dˈaʊt ɐbˌaʊt wɒt tʃˈeɪndʒd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The recycling rate has fallen since the new bins arrived.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪsˈaɪklɪŋ ɹˈeɪt hɐz fˈɔːlən sˈɪns ðə njˈuː bˈɪnz ɐɹˈaɪvd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are residents confused by the colours?
lines.ipa: /ɑː ɹˈɛzɪdənts kənfjˈuːzd baɪ ðə kˈʌləz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Possibly. The colours mean something different in the neighbouring town.
lines.ipa: /pˈɒsɪbli ðə kˈʌləz mˈiːn sˈʌmθɪŋ dˈɪfɹənt ɪnðə nˈeɪbəɹɪŋ tˈaʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use labels with examples instead of expecting everyone to know the local system.
lines.ipa: /jˈuːs lˈeɪbəlz wɪð ɛɡzˈampəlz ɪnstˈɛd ɒv ɛkspˈɛktɪŋ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn tə nˈəʊ ðə lˈəʊkəl sˈɪstəm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The council installed a water-saving tap, but it now runs for too long.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˈaʊnsəl ɪnstˈɔːld ɐ wˈɔːtəsˈeɪvɪŋ tˈap bˌʌt ɪt nˈaʊ ɹˈʌnz fɔː tˈuː lˈɒŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has anyone reported the actual fault?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ˈɛnɪwˌɒn ɹɪpˈɔːtɪd ðɪ ˈaktʃuːəl fˈɒlt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The maintenance request just says the new tap is unpopular.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈeɪntənəns ɹɪkwˈɛst dʒˈʌst sˈɛz ðə njˈuː tˈap ɪz ʌnpˈɒpjʊlə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Describe the problem precisely so it reaches the right team.
lines.ipa: /dɪskɹˈaɪb ðə pɹˈɒbləm pɹɪsˈaɪsli sˌəʊ ɪt ɹˈiːtʃɪz ðə ɹˈaɪt tˈiːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The school planted trees for an event, but several died over the summer.
lines.ipa: /ðə skˈuːl plˈantɪd tɹˈiːz fəɹən ɪvˈɛnt bˌʌt sˈɛvɹəl dˈaɪd ˌəʊvə ðə sˈʌmə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was anyone responsible for watering them during the holidays?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ˈɛnɪwˌɒn ɹɪspˈɒnsɪbəl fɔː wˈɔːtəɹɪŋ ðˌɛm djˈʊəɹɪŋ ðə hˈɒlɪdˌeɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Each group assumed another group was doing it.
lines.ipa: /ˈiːtʃ ɡɹˈuːp ɐsjˈuːmd ɐnˈʌðə ɡɹˈuːp wɒz dˈuːɪŋ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The next planting plan needs a maintenance plan too.
lines.ipa: /ðə nˈɛkst plˈantɪŋ plˈan nˈiːdz ɐ mˈeɪntənəns plˈan tˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Volunteers spent the morning collecting litter, then left full bags beside the river.
lines.ipa: /vˌɒləntˈiəz spˈɛnt ðə mˈɔːnɪŋ kəlˈɛktɪŋ lˈɪtə ðˈɛn lˈɛft fˈʊl bˈaɡz bɪsˌaɪd ðə ɹˈɪvə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was a collection arranged?
lines.ipa: /wʌzɐ kəlˈɛkʃən ɐɹˈeɪndʒd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They expected the usual waste service to take them.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ɛkspˈɛktɪd ðə jˈuːʒuːəl wˈeɪst sˈɜːvɪs tə tˈeɪk ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We should confirm the final step before inviting people to do the first one.
lines.ipa: /wiː ʃˌʊd kənfˈɜːm ðə fˈaɪnəl stˈɛp bɪfˌɔːɹ ɪnvˈaɪtɪŋ pˈiːpəl tə dˈuː ðə fˈɜːst wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The community market wants more local sellers but has raised the stall fee.
lines.ipa: /ðə kəmjˈuːnɪti mˈɑːkɪt wˈɒnts mˈɔː lˈəʊkəl sˈɛləz bˌʌt hɐz ɹˈeɪzd ðə stˈɔːl fˈiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is the increase covering a specific new cost?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðɪ ˈɪŋkɹiːs kˈʌvəɹɪŋ ɐ spəsˈɪfɪk njˈuː kˈɒst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mostly advertising outside the area.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊstli ˈadvətˌaɪzɪŋ aʊtsˈaɪd ðɪ ˈeəɹiə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then ask whether that spending helps the small sellers the market wants to attract.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ˈask wˈɛðə ðat spˈɛndɪŋ hˈɛlps ðə smˈɔːl sˈɛləz ðə mˈɑːkɪt wˈɒnts tʊ ɐtɹˈakt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The tool-sharing project is busy, but the same two people repair everything.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈuːlʃˈeəɹɪŋ pɹˈɒdʒɛkt ɪz bˈɪzi bˌʌt ðə sˈeɪm tˈuː pˈiːpəl ɹɪpˈeəɹ ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do users know how much time maintenance takes?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː jˈuːzəz nˈəʊ hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ tˈaɪm mˈeɪntənəns tˈeɪks/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They only see the borrowing calendar.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ˈəʊnli sˈiː ðə bˈɒɹəʊɪŋ kˈaləndə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Show the work behind the service and invite people to share it.
lines.ipa: /ʃˈəʊ ðə wˈɜːk bɪhˌaɪnd ðə sˈɜːvɪs and ɪnvˈaɪt pˈiːpəl tə ʃˈeəɹ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: People keep saying reusable cups are always the greener choice.
lines.ipa: /pˈiːpəl kˈiːp sˈeɪɪŋ ɹiːjˈuːzəbəl kˈʌps ɑːɹ ˈɔːlweɪz ðə ɡɹˈiːnə tʃˈɔɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does that include how often they're used and washed?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ðat ɪŋklˈuːd hˌaʊ ˈɒfən ðeɪə jˈuːzd and wˈɒʃt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nobody has measured that here.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊbɒdi hɐz mˈɛʒəd ðat hˈiə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's find out about our actual use before printing a confident claim.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛts fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt ɐbˌaʊt ˌaʊəɹ ˈaktʃuːəl jˈuːs bɪfˌɔː pɹˈɪntɪŋ ɐ kˈɒnfɪdənt klˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The cycle lane is protected except for the busiest part of the road.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈaɪkəl lˈeɪn ɪz pɹətˈɛktɪd ɛksˈɛpt fəðə bˈɪziɪst pˈɑːt ɒvðə ɹˈəʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Why was that section left out?
lines.ipa: /wˌaɪ wɒz ðat sˈɛkʃən lˈɛft ˈaʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It would remove a few parking spaces.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wʊd ɹɪmˈuːv ɐ fjˈuː pˈɑːkɪŋ spˈeɪsɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the safety claim needs to be weighed against the route people really have to take.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə sˈeɪfti klˈeɪm nˈiːdz təbi wˈeɪd ɐɡˈɛnst ðə ɹˈuːt pˈiːpəl ɹˈiəlɪ hav tə tˈeɪk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our public meeting was well attended, but only five people spoke.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə pˈʌblɪk mˈiːtɪŋ wɒz wˈɛl ɐtˈɛndɪd bˌʌt ˈəʊnli fˈaɪv pˈiːpəl spˈəʊk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were there other ways to give feedback?
lines.ipa: /wɜː ðeəɹ ˈʌðə wˈeɪz tə ɡˈɪv fˈiːdbak/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, and several people left before questions began.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ and sˈɛvɹəl pˈiːpəl lˈɛft bɪfˌɔː kwˈɛstʃənz bɪɡˈan/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Offer a quieter way to contribute rather than assuming silence means agreement.
lines.ipa: /ˈɒfəɹ ɐ kwˈaɪətə wˈeɪ tə kəntɹˈɪbjuːt ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɐsjˈuːmɪŋ sˈaɪləns mˈiːnz ɐɡɹˈiːmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The winning project has the most supporters online, but serves only one street.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɪnɪŋ pɹˈɒdʒɛkt hɐz ðə mˈəʊst səpˈɔːtəz ˈɒnlaɪn bˌʌt sˈɜːvz ˈəʊnli wˈɒn stɹˈiːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the grant meant to reward popularity or wider benefit?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə ɡɹˈant mˈɛnt tə ɹɪwˈɔːd pˌɒpjʊlˈaɹɪti ɔː wˈaɪdə bˈɛnɪfˌɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The rules never made that clear.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈuːlz nˈɛvə mˌeɪd ðat klˈiə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We should settle the criteria before asking residents to vote again.
lines.ipa: /wiː ʃˌʊd sˈɛtəl ðə kɹaɪtˈiəɹɪə bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈaskɪŋ ɹˈɛzɪdənts tə vˈəʊt ɐɡˈɛn/
